parts.html: The K-43 kitchen is a modern straight model where the contrast of color and texture takes center stage. The lower cabinets and tall side units are finished in a deep dark burgundy, wine-like shade. The central upper row, by contrast, is dark graphite with a pronounced vertical ribbed texture. This combination makes the kitchen look sleek, contemporary, and memorable.

The main design feature of the K-43 is the interplay between smooth burgundy fronts and a textured graphite upper section. As a result, the kitchen looks not just dark but multilayered. Burgundy adds depth and richness, while the graphite upper row creates an architectural accent line across the entire width of the work area.

The work surface is designed in a single dark palette. The countertop looks black or very dark, and the backsplash follows the same color concept. As a result, the work area reads as one solid block, with the ribbed upper fronts seeming to hover above it and emphasizing the kitchen’s modern minimalist character.

The interior visualization clearly shows a tall dark burgundy unit with a built-in oven on the left. On the right is another tall closed unit in the same wine shade. Between them runs the main work line of the kitchen, with base cabinets below and the graphite upper row above.
Layout and dimensions
The K-43 has a straight configuration. The entire furniture composition is placed along one wall, making the model well suited to modern apartments, condos, and open-plan living spaces.
The kitchen is 4.1 linear meters long. The model’s standard overall dimensions are 4.1 × 2.4 × 0.6 m.

This solution brings storage, the work surface, built-in appliances, and tall pantry units together in a single run. With custom design, the placement of the sink, cooktop, appliances, and interior storage systems can be adapted to the specific room and its utility connections.

The model is designed for built-in appliances. This means the kitchen is planned around the placement of built-in units, but the appliances themselves are not automatically included in the standard price of the furniture.
A separate kitchen island is not included in the standard configuration.
Materials and decorative finish

The upper and lower fronts of the K-43 kitchen are made of laminated chipboard. The model’s base color is red, and in the interior it reads as a richer color composition, with dark burgundy lower fronts and a graphite upper row.

The lower cabinets and both tall side units are finished in a deep wine-burgundy shade. The central upper fronts are dark graphite with a ribbed vertical surface that serves as one of the key decorative elements of the entire model.
The carcass is made of 18 mm thick laminated chipboard.
The countertop is chipboard-based. In the visualization, it has a very dark, almost black finish. The kitchen backsplash follows the same dark palette, visually continuing the work surface.

The base specification lists the decor as solid-color; in practice, however, the kitchen’s visual character relies not only on color but also on contrasting textures: smooth burgundy surfaces are paired with a ribbed graphite upper section.
Hardware and functionality
The standard K-43 configuration uses Hettich hinges with a soft-close mechanism, ensuring that hinged fronts close smoothly.
Drawers are fitted with Quadro Hettich concealed undermount slides. This solution keeps the interior components looking neat and supports the overall minimalist character of the kitchen.
A cargo pull-out is not included in the standard configuration.
There are no lift-up mechanisms.

According to the technical specification, handles are included; however, in the visualization the fronts look sleek and modern, with an emphasis on clean lines and dark horizontal profile strips separating the cabinet tiers.
Additional options
At the client’s request, the K-43 kitchen can be supplemented with more functional cabinet hardware, alternative opening mechanisms, and additional interior storage systems.

The kitchen can also be made from alternative materials, both more budget-friendly and premium. The hardware level, front materials, countertop, interior fittings, and a number of structural solutions can be selected individually.
These items are additional options and are not part of the standard configuration of the K-43 model.

Custom K-43 kitchen in Bratislava and Vienna
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-43 model can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room, with adjustments to the length of the composition, the placement of built-in appliances, the interior storage systems, and the finishing materials. When ordering, you can choose a different front color, change the hardware level, select another countertop, and add extra functional solutions.

We offer furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. At the client’s request, we can also select a sink, faucet, range hood, and appliances.
